headline_discovery.what: For the first time in this project's recorded history, REAL TRAFFIC was observable and it is NOT zero.
headline_discovery.source: the Telegraph getPage API returns a 'views' field that had never been queried before

OBSERVED.note: every single one of the 63 articles has at least one view

headline_discovery.why_this_matters: The working assumption for many cycles was 'no traffic'. That is now falsified for the Telegraph channel. The real diagnosis is TRAFFIC ARRIVES BUT DOES NOT CONVERT: 238 observed views, 53 of 63 articles containing a product link, and 0 orders.
headline_discovery.what_it_does_not_change: It does not make the products sell. It relocates the problem from 'nobody sees us' to 'the people who see us do not buy', which is a different and more tractable problem.
